title: Tensor pullback comparison around an etale commutative square
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, h:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′ be morphisms of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], and suppose g,h are representably etale and h≫f=f′≫g. Use the specified module tensor pullbacks and chart-unit tensor sections [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. There exists a natural isomorphism f^* followed by restriction along h ≅ restriction along g followed by f′^*. For every module M on Y, etale scheme V→Y′, chart q=(T→X′,T→V) for f′ over V, a,b in Γ(T,O_T), and m in M(gV), it sends a times the chart tensor b⊗m on the transported chart (T→X′→X,T→V) to the f′ chart tensor (a*b)⊗m in f′^*(M|Y′). The square need only commute: it is not required to be cartesian.

proof.text: Apply normalized chart tensor realization to the pairs (f,h) and (g,f′). Their composition comparisons identify the two tensor paths with tensor pullback along h≫f and f′≫g. The square equality identifies those composite morphisms.

Representably etale maps are chartwise etale by isEtale_comp. The etale clause of chart realization identifies the two horizontal tensor pullbacks with literal restriction by multiplication and insertion of one. Conjugate the composition comparisons by these identifications.

Compute locally: write a restricted section as 1 tensor that section, apply the first composition to multiply the outer coefficient with the pullback of the inner coefficient, and apply the inverse comparison on the other path to insert one. Etale multiplication removes that unit. The chart map for both coefficients is the identity of T, so the result is (a*b) tensor m. Balancing proves inverse identities before sheafification. The chart-normalized units transfer the formulas to the specified adjunctions.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_tensor_square_comparison
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (hg : IsEtale g.hom.hom) (hh : IsEtale h.hom.hom)
    (w : h.hom ≫ f.hom = f'.hom ≫ g.hom) :
    let transport : ∀ V : Y'.EtaleSite, ModuleChart f' V →
        ModuleChart f ((etaleMap g hg).obj V) := fun V q ↦
      CostructuredArrow.mk (Y := (etaleMap h hh).obj q.left)
        (CostructuredArrow.homMk q.hom.left (by
          have hw : h.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom = f'.hom.hom ≫ g.hom.hom :=
            congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom) w
          have hq : yoneda.map q.hom.left ≫ V.obj.hom =
              q.left.obj.hom ≫ f'.hom.hom := by
            exact CostructuredArrow.w q.hom
          change yoneda.map q.hom.left ≫ (V.obj.hom ≫ g.hom.hom) =
            q.left.obj.hom ≫ h.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom
          rw [← Category.assoc, hq, Category.assoc, hw]))
    ∃ lambda : moduleTensorPullback f ⋙ pullback h hh ≅
        pullback g hg ⋙ moduleTensorPullback f',
      ∀ (M : Y.Modules) (V : Y'.EtaleSite) (q : ModuleChart f' V)
        (a b : X'.structureSheaf.obj.obj (op q.left))
        (m : M.val.obj (op ((etaleMap g hg).obj V))),
        (lambda.hom.app M).val.app (op q.left)
            (a • moduleTensorSection f M ((etaleMap g hg).obj V) (transport V q) b m) =
          moduleTensorSection f' ((pullback g hg).obj M) V q (a * b) m
